local P=game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.PlayerGui local V=workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize local out={} local n=0 local btns={} for _,d in ipairs(P:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("GuiObject") and d.Visible and d.AbsoluteSize.X>1 then local g=d:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui") if g and g.Enabled and g.Name~="Chat" then if (d:IsA("TextButton") or d:IsA("TextLabel")) and d.Text~="" then n+=1 local inScroll=d:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScrollingFrame")~=nil if d.TextBounds.X>d.AbsoluteSize.X+3 or d.TextBounds.Y>d.AbsoluteSize.Y+3 then table.insert(out,"CUT["..string.sub(d.Text,1,24).."] box="..math.floor(d.AbsoluteSize.X).."x"..math.floor(d.AbsoluteSize.Y).." text="..math.floor(d.TextBounds.X).."x"..math.floor(d.TextBounds.Y)) end if not inScroll and (d.AbsolutePosition.X+d.AbsoluteSize.X>V.X+3 or d.AbsolutePosition.Y+d.AbsoluteSize.Y>V.Y+3 or d.AbsolutePosition.X<-3) then table.insert(out,"OFF["..string.sub(d.Text,1,24).."]") end if d:IsA("TextButton") and not inScroll then table.insert(btns,d) end end end end end for i=1,#btns do for j=i+1,#btns do local a,b=btns[i],btns[j] if a.Parent==b.Parent and a.ZIndex==b.ZIndex then local ox=math.min(a.AbsolutePosition.X+a.AbsoluteSize.X,b.AbsolutePosition.X+b.AbsoluteSize.X)-math.max(a.AbsolutePosition.X,b.AbsolutePosition.X) local oy=math.min(a.AbsolutePosition.Y+a.AbsoluteSize.Y,b.AbsolutePosition.Y+b.AbsoluteSize.Y)-math.max(a.AbsolutePosition.Y,b.AbsolutePosition.Y) if ox>6 and oy>6 and #a.Text>0 and #b.Text>0 then table.insert(out,"OVERLAP["..string.sub(a.Text,1,12).."|"..string.sub(b.Text,1,12).."]") end end end end local msg="" for i=1,math.min(#out,14) do msg=msg.." ; "..out[i] end return "CHK deck view="..math.floor(V.X).."x"..math.floor(V.Y).." texts="..n.." issues="..#out..msg
